name: wc-budget-80
displayName: 预算预警(滚动 30 天累计达 80%)
description: 按 event_id 去重后的 llm_call 费用累计 ≥ 员工预算的 80%;SLS 相对时间无自然月,先用滚动 30 天,实施时若支持自然月再改;user_max_budget 可能是字符串(Decimal 经 default=str),用 try_cast 转 double

queryList.query: event_type: llm_call and status: success | select employee_id, round(sum(cost_usd),4) as spent, max(budget) as budget from (select distinct event_id, employee_id, cost_usd, try_cast(user_max_budget as double) as budget from log) group by employee_id having max(budget) > 0 and sum(cost_usd) >= 0.8 * max(budget)

annotations.value: 滚动 30 天累计;在 https://windows-control.teenet.app 员工页调整额度
